name: Sunflower oil
description: Oil extracted from sunflower seeds (Helianthus annuusL.).

name: Wheat distillers grains, starch < 7%, dried
description: Byproduct of alcohol (ethanol) manufacture, obtained from the distillery of wheat grains (Triticum aestivumL., also known asTriticum aestivumL. subsp.aestivum), consisting of spent grains and steepwater solubles in variable proportions. This process uses the whole grain without bran separation, resulting in distillers grains containing less starch (< 7% as fed) than those resulting from a process where the bran is separated before starch extraction and reintroduced at the end. Other names and alternative spellings: wheat DDGS, wheat distillers' grains, wheat distiller's grains.

name: Ca Al Fe phosphate
description: Phosphate minerals based on the phosphate anion and the elements calcium, aluminium and iron.

name: Rice bran, oil > 5%, crude fibre > 20%
description: Byproduct of the processing of rice grain (Oryza sativaL.), consisting in envelopes, germs and fragments of endosperm. This product has not been defatted and contains significant amounts of hulls. Other name: full-fat rice bran.

name: DL-methionine
description: DL-methionine produced by chemical synthesis.

name: Calcium sulfate anhydrous
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula CaSO4. Alternative spelling: calcium sulphate (UK).

name: Rice bran, oil < 5%, crude fibre 5-11%
description: Byproduct of the processing of rice grain (Oryza sativaL.), consisting in envelopes, germs and fragments of endosperm. This product has been defatted. Other name: defatted rice bran.

name: Grapeseed oil meal
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of grape seeds (Vitis viniferaL.).

name: Oats
description: Oat grain (Avena sativaL.).

name: Rice hulls
description: Byproduct of the processing of rice grain (Oryza sativaL.), consisting mostly in outer grain envelopes.

name: Molasses, sugarcane
description: Syrupy byproduct of sugar manufacture, obtained from the crystallisation of cane sugar (Saccharum officinarumL.).

name: Wheat feed flour
description: Byproduct of wheat flour production obtained by the milling of wheat grains (Triticum aestivumL., also known asTriticum aestivumL. subsp.aestivum).  It consists principally of particles of endosperm with fine fragments of the outer skins.

name: Magnesium hydroxide
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula Mg(OH)2.

name: Bananas, immature, dried
description: Dried, immature fruits of the banana tree (Musasp.). Starch is the main carbohydrate of immature bananas and is transformed into solubles sugars during ripening.

name: Rice, paddy
description: Whole rice grain (Oryza sativaL.) with the hulls included. Paddy rice is further decorticated into brown rice (elimination of the hulls), pearled (elimination of the germ and pericarp) and polished.

name: Copra meal, oil < 5%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained after extraction from the dried kernels (copra) of the coconut fruit (Cocos nuciferaL.). This product has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. Other names: copra oil meal, coconut meal, coconut oil meal.

name: Magnesium oxide, granular
description: Inorganic chemical compound with the formula MgO. Granular form: 25% of particles > 500µ. Other name: magnesia.

name: Alfalfa protein concentrate
description: Protein concentrate obtained by pressing the aerial part of alfalfa (Medicago sativaL.). In one commercial process, fresh alfalfa is first pressed to obtain a green juice. This juice is then heated and steamed to produce a protein coagulate. This coagulate is separated from the liquid by centrifugation, and then dried. Alfalfa protein concentrate is used for its high content in protein and pigments (caroten, xanthophylls).

name: Groundnut meal, oil < 5%, crude fibre < 9%
description: Byproduct of oil manufacture obtained by extraction of groundnut seeds (Arachis hypogaeaL.). The relatively low fibre content is due to the limited amount of skins and shells. It has a low content in residual oil and results from mechanical pressure followed by solvent extraction. Other names: peanut meal, peanut oil meal.

name: Dolomite limestone
description: Dolomite is a sedimentary rock composed of the minerals calcite and aragonite, which are different crystal forms of calcium carbonate (CaCO3), and of up to 50% dolomite (CaMg(CO3)2).
